title: Advanced Canopy and Flowering Specialist Practical

domains.name: Maturity sampling and harvest decision logic

criticalErrors: Makes an irreversible canopy or harvest recommendation without verifying crop identity, stage, or representative evidence.
Treats a single flower or single sensor position as conclusive evidence for the entire crop when contradictory spatial evidence is provided.
Fails to identify a supplied reproductive or contamination risk that requires immediate isolation or escalation.
Alters or fabricates measurement, maturity, or crop-observation evidence.
